reason: I don't move my team's client work onto something I can't find a single G2 or Capterra review for. The price is fine, but if this vendor folds or breaks mid-project, it's my clients who feel it.
objection: It's a brand-new tool with no track record and no reviews. Client pages that pull in every email and meeting sound great until the startup disappears and I'm stuck migrating mid-project.
would_change_my_mind: A solid set of real reviews on G2 or Capterra from studios our size, plus some proof the company will still be around in two years.
